review.notes: Full review. Sample: all 15 seeded targets plus the headline theorems, each with computed instances in the adversarial table. Pins: structure-sheaf API and the manifold inverse function theorem opened in Tau Ceti; Mathlib LocalDiffeomorph checked. Suppliers resolved on main: RealAnalyticGeometry 3.0-3.2 and 4.1, ComplexKahlerGeometry 3.4 and 4.5, ComplexManifolds 7.3, ComplexComparisonPartII C4.1. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks: the sorried definition is real (R01); the process-word and undeclared-name hits were set aside as false positives. Elaboration of a scratch copy: a real body for pullbackAlgHom elaborates; no sorried theorem closes in one tactic. The sources service recorded the two fetched texts and one uncertified entry in the package manifest while fetching.
